FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A01
DUI scope erases the legal-illegal drug line and the alcohol-medicine line with age lowering tolerance, illegal-after triggers triple across alcohol, drugs, and mixes with label reading and refusal penalties attached, teen bicycling draws driving sanctions, and container law pairs sealed-carry against trunk-only open storage with transit exemptions [A01].

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A02
BAC limits staircase by age, probation, and license class with impairment convictable below every line, table math pairs drink-gender-weight estimates against time-decay subtraction and standard-drink definitions, and vessels extend the ban offshore [A02].
Why it matters: group bac; difficulty high; prereq sec09-R01; confusables sec09-F05, sec09-F06, sec09-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A03
Implied consent stacks breath, blood, and urine with PAS never excusing drug screens and refusal ending driving, arrests pair Admin Per Se suspension against thirty-day temps and ten-day hearing windows, and convictions stack year-long loss, programs, insurance proof, fees, interlocks, jail, fines, impounds, suits, and decade-long records [A03].
Why it matters: group arrest-conviction; difficulty high; prereq sec09-R02; confusables sec09-F08, sec09-F09 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A04
Under-twenty-one possession pairs the adult-companion rule against sealed-container and trunk-storage geometry with a liquor-work exception, getting caught pairs impounds against fines, suspensions, and licensing delays, and consumption pairs test-on-suspicion against the zero-one revocation line and the zero-five arrest line [A04].
Why it matters: group under-21; difficulty high; prereq sec09-R03; confusables sec09-F10, sec09-F11, sec09-F12 [A04].
